answer_4.quote: We ran three annotation jobs, and, in all cases, annotators were allowed to provide feedback on the generation errors. ... annotators inspected 30 sequences of images generated with different methods ... they were asked to select the best, second best, and third best sequences ... we asked annotators to rate each sequence in a 5 point Likert scale.
